nodes.rationale: Preserve the original 2D authored gameplay through independently playable milestones; original files remain untouched.

nodes.label: CheckpointSave
nodes.rationale: Bench snapshot must include compatible run, room and bench IDs, archive signature, room caches, decisions and flags; reload resumes the bench snapshot. Death, new run and endings clear it.

nodes.label: Memory and style loadout
nodes.rationale: Remembered archive entries influence the world independently of equipped identity. Memory switching is allowed at title/loadout, near a bench or Wake safe start; styles require completed rest.

nodes.label: Completed bench rest
nodes.rationale: Rest takes 0.45 seconds, restores six integrity, clears fracture, grants at least one Resonance, resets ability cooldown and saves run; actions or damage interrupt it.

nodes.label: Original combat parity
nodes.rationale: Validate timing boundaries, facing, red attacks bypassing dash protection, late block debt, strain/maturity imprint damage, pogo and one-time input consumption during hitstop.

nodes.label: Archive, run, encounter, checkpoint and settings lifetimes
nodes.rationale: Separating persistent archive, current decisions and equipped identity prevents progression drift.

nodes.label: Effective room geometry
nodes.rationale: Exported art-manifest geometry overrides world JSON; memory geometry is applied afterward.

nodes.label: PlayerMotor
nodes.rationale: Explicit axis-by-axis collision queries and 1/120 fixed simulation preserve reference movement; sprite interpolation is separate.

nodes.label: MovementInput
nodes.rationale: Rendered-frame input edges are buffered and consumed once per physics step.

nodes.label: Phase 1 validation
nodes.rationale: 26 EditMode and 4 PlayMode tests passed; physical controller, sustained hardware 144 Hz and Windows build checks remain.

nodes.label: Wake, Procession, Belfry, Cistern and Archive

nodes.label: Slice combat systems
nodes.rationale: Implements chain, press/release charged cuts, directional attacks, recovery buffer, dash cancel, defenses, fracture, Resonance, imprint, mend and pogo; full parity is not certified.

nodes.label: Versioned Wake archive
nodes.rationale: wake-slice-v1.json validates mercy/fire/return, uses temporary write and atomic replacement with backup, recovers corrupt primary without overwriting it, and permits retry after save failure.

nodes.label: Transfer extraction
nodes.rationale: Exactly one mercy, fire or fallback return advances life and becomes equipped; repeats do not duplicate entries. Run enemies, collectibles, shortcuts and visits reset.
